blocks.text: 🔗Major Blockchain Networks EVM‑Compatible Networks(same address format): Ethereum Binance Smart Chain (BSC) Polygon Avalanche (C‑Chain) Arbitrum Optimism Fantom Base Non‑EVM Networks(different address formats): Bitcoin Solana Tron Cardano XRP Ledger Aptos Sui

blocks.prompt: Would you live in a fast city, a cheap city, or a secure city?

blocks.text: 🧠Core Difference EVM (Ethereum Virtual Machine):Executes smart contracts using the same logic Non‑EVM:Uses different programming and execution models 🧠How to Spot Wallet Addresses EVM Address:Starts with 0x (same on Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, etc.) Bitcoin Address:Starts with 1, 3, or bc1 Solana Address:Long random letters and numbers (no 0x) Tron Address:Starts with T Sending funds to the wrong network can result inpermanent loss.
